mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% over the prior month signals imminent monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 3.9%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 500000 indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105 indicates manufacturing sector expansion, increasing corporate capacity utilization and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 19200 billion dollars signals sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 19200.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 255 indicates persistent inflation, triggering aggressive monetary policy responses that increase equity discount rates and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS > 150000) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 3.8) signal a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 150000 and UNRATE is below 3.8.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 255 signals aggressive interest rate policy, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0 and CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.
